name: Natsukawa Kyouko
source:
An airheaded girl who is easy to talk too. She's classmates with the protagonist and [url=/c73422]Kasugano Mariko[/url] and has been friends with Mariko since she was young.
She's smart, but a little careless and often mistakes which answer goes in which box on tests.
Her partner spirit Kyan has quite the opposite high spirited personality.
